elevator_pitch: An all-in-one 2-layer flight camera PCB integrating the ESP32-CAM module, a 6-axis IMU, barometric altitude sensor, and microSD card logging — purpose-built for high-power rocketry and high-speed planes.
description:
• 2-layer flight computer fusing an MPU6050 IMU and BME280 barometer with GPIO-synchronized video timestamps for frame-accurate post-flight analysis.

• Solid GND reference plane under all high-speed SPI traces keeps camera, SD card and sensor data clean.

• Board is flight-ready in under 60 seconds no SD card removal needed between flights.
